title: Postpartum Confinement Center
synopsis: In China, new mothers traditionally spend a month in confinement after giving birth to their child, called 月子. Here we see an advertisement for a confinement center for new mothers.

fullText.simplified:
快乐月子中心简介

    快乐月子中心－新妈妈的最好选择！在这里，新妈妈们可以在轻松、温馨的环境中享受月子中的快乐，体会做妈妈的幸福时光。
    或许忙碌的生活曾让您奔波在社会的各个角落，或许宝宝的到来让您手忙脚乱！来快乐月子中心吧！您和家里人什么都不用做，您只要放松自己，去享受各种服务项目，去抚摸一下宝宝，去感受一下轻松温馨的环境……
    快乐月子中心，您温馨的家。我们倡导合理科学化的月子新生活，认真服务每一位妈妈及宝宝。真正做到让家人省心、放心、开心。让妈妈和宝宝开心度过月子中的每一天。
    快乐月子中心，您温馨的家。30天的月子，微笑服务、为您所想。产后健康指导、营养调理、宝宝护理等等一系列的专业服务，让妈妈及宝宝享受幸福月子时光。
    快乐月子中心，优惠的价格，优质的服务，让您：“科学坐月子，幸福一辈子！”。您还在等什么，赶快来吧。
联系电话：18308947812
fullText.traditional:
快樂月子中心簡介

    快樂月子中心－新媽媽的最好選擇！在這裡，新媽媽們可以在輕鬆、溫馨的環境中享受月子中的快樂，體會做媽媽的幸福時光。
    或許忙碌的生活曾讓您奔波在社會的各個角落，或許寶寶的到來讓您手忙腳亂！來快樂月子中心吧！您和家里人什麼都不用做，您只要放鬆自己，去享受各種服務項目，去撫摸一下寶寶，去感受一下輕鬆溫馨的環境……
    快樂月子中心，您溫馨的家。我們倡導合理科學化的月子新生活，認真服務每一位媽媽及寶寶。真正做到讓家人省心、放心、開心。讓媽媽和寶寶開心度過月子中的每一天。
    快樂月子中心，您溫馨的家。30天的月子，微笑服務、為您所想。產後健康指導、營養調理、寶寶護理等等一系列的專業服務，讓媽媽及寶寶享受幸福月子時光。
    快樂月子中心，優惠的價格，優質的服務，讓您：“科學坐月子，幸福一輩子！”。您還在等什麼，趕快來吧。
聯繫電話：18308947812

raw.synopsis: In China, new mothers traditionally spend a month in confinement after giving birth to their child, called 月子. Here we see an advertisement for a confinement center for new mothers.
sentence_translations: Happy Postpartum Confinement Center Introduction
Happy Postpartum Confinement Center - The best choice for new mothers!
Here, new mothers can enjoy the happiness of postpartum confinement in a relaxed, comfortable environment, ..
.. and experience the blessed period of being a mother.
Perhaps a busy lifestyle has caused you to rush about in every corner of society, or the arrival of your baby has you flustered.
Why not come to the Happy Postpartum Confinement Center!
You and your family do not have to do anything, you can just relax yourself and enjoy the different events, ..
.. caress your baby and experience the relaxed and comfortable environment.
Happy Postpartum Confinement Center, your comfortable home.
We advocate a rational scientific postpartum confinement lifestyle and earnestly service every mother and child.
We will truly do everything so that your family is spared worry, and can feel at ease and happy.
We help the mother and baby spend each day of the postpartum confinement happily.
Happy Postpartum Confinement Center, your comfortable home.
30 days of postpartum confinement; service with a smile, we think of everything for you.
Postnatal health guidance, nutrition control, baby nursing, etc., complete series of professional service,
.. allows the mother and child enjoy a happy postpartum confinement period.
Happy Postpartum Confinement Center's favorable pricing and superior quality service lets you:
“Spend a scientific postpartum period and enjoy happiness for the rest of your life!”
What are you waiting for, hurry up and get here!
Contact phone number: 18308947812
